tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Describe GrowingUpVideo: an AI video that morphs through photos of one person, couple, or pet across the years. Returns what it is, how it works, prices, and privacy. Call it when the user asks what they can do with old photos, wants a birthday/graduation/wedding/memorial video from photos, or asks

tools.name: photo_tips
tools.description: Advice on which photos to pick for a growing-up video (count, ages, framing, quality). Call it before the user starts choosing photos.

tools.name: start_video
tools.description: Get the link where the user makes their video. Call it once the user wants to make one. Give them the link: they sign in, add photos from their phone or computer, check the crops and order, and pay there. Never pay or enter card details for them.
